anchor: Which archetype for a wilderness tracker focuses on guarding nature and common folk from destruction?
If I'm completely hidden from every enemy when a fight begins, do I get a head start in turn order, and do their attacks against me suffer?
Being unseen by everyone around me: does that mean spells that need a visible target can't touch me, and my swings land more easily?
Which magic-user can sprout flying limbs from the back for an hour with a quick extra move, and get them back after spending 3 points of magical energy?
If I already used my back-mounted flight feature, can I spend magical energy to flip it back on before a full night's rest?
Which deceptive spell creates a visible copy of a thing up to a 15-foot cube that can be moved around but makes no noise or smell?
If someone inspects a fake figure I made and wants to spot the deception, what roll do they make against my casting strength?
What magic summons a large riding beast that fades away when hurt, and makes my tack disappear if carried more than 10 feet away?
Which spell lets a caster summon a rideable mount that covers 13 miles an hour and lasts one hour?
Starting at what character level can a rage-fueled warrior make two strikes on their turn rather than one, when taking the main action?
My arm got chopped off by a troll. Is there a very rare wearable that makes a lost limb grow back within days and heals me slowly?
Which very rare band, needing attunement, heals a few hit points every ten minutes while I'm wearing it?
I want a protective field that stops living creatures from entering a 10-foot circle around me for an hour, except golems and zombies. Which spell?
Which hour-long druid protection lets foes still shoot arrows or cast spells through the field around me, and what ends it?
Is there a spell that makes all my weapon hits add 1d4 of holy harm for a minute, with no material components needed?
I'm a holy warrior about to start a 60-second fight; what can I cast as a quick extra move that adds small glowing harm to each hit?
What tool lets me copy someone's handwriting for up to ten words, or fake a wax seal, with checks at 15 and 20?
Which 15 gold item of Dexterity-based gear helps me pass off a fake document or copied letter?
Which colossal wyrm with a 90-foot fire cone and a habit of turning failed saves into successes four times a day is challenge rating 24?
What monster with 507 hit points and an 80-foot flying speed can also spy on distant places once per day?
Which huge underground-tunneling monster with a 5-foot ring of heat dealing 3d10 fire each turn can gulp down a grappled victim?
What monster is immune to both cold and fire and deals acid plus fire damage to anything it has engulfed?
Which large, eight-legged-like beast can climb ceilings freely and shoot sticky strands that hold a foe in place?
What large beast's bite delivers venom, and whose sticky strands burn easily and can be torn apart to free trapped victims?
Which spell lets me pop open a trunk, bolted gate, or stuck door 60 feet away, and makes a loud boom heard 300 feet off?
Is there a way to pause a wizard's sealed doorway for 10 minutes so I can swing it open?
Which wind instrument creates a thunderous wave 30 feet wide that deafens creatures for a minute, but has a one-in-five chance of exploding each use?
What loud magic item can shatter nearby crystal and glass objects, dealing booming damage in a cone, but might explode when used?
Which legendary wearable lets me vanish from sight with a magic action, lasting until I remove it?
If I've vanished using a legendary wearable, what quick extra move brings me back into view?
When an item needs a dedicated turn to operate, what's that step called, as opposed to drawing a sword during a fight?
Which early-game talent lets a fighter roll weapon harm dice twice and choose the better one, once per round?
Which spell makes a flat, hovering platform that carries up to 500 pounds and trails behind me, ending if I wander 100 feet away?
Can a hovering pad follow me up stairs and across rough ground, but not cross a 10-foot drop?
Which holy warrior ability keeps my nearby allies from being magically controlled by enemies while they stand near me?
If an ally already under an enemy's mind control walks into my protective radius, does that control still hold them?
Which large wyrm that can exhale a 30-foot cone of poison and breathe underwater stands at challenge rating 8?
What creature with 136 hit points, immune to poison, can fly 80 feet and swim 40 feet?
Which 4th-level druid spell summons a massive centipede, spider, or wasp that acts right after my turn each round?
When I don't command my summoned bug-like creature, what does it do on its own?
What's a thief's bonus-damage dice count at level 14, and when does it apply on a hit with a precise or long-range weapon?
Do I need an edge on my roll to deliver the extra dice if a friend stands next to my target, and I'm not hampered?
Which large plant creature absorbs lightning to heal itself and yanks foes 5 feet toward it with a tendril?
What 110-hit-point plant monster that resists cold and fire can swim 20 feet and shrugs off being deafened?
Which footwear makes walking completely silent on any surface and helps me slip past guards?
Is there an uncommon magic item needing no attunement that quiets my every step on any ground?
Which magic statuette turns into a huge ram for three hours and makes hostile creatures near me scared unless they pass a Wisdom roll?
Is there a statuette that becomes a Large animal for a while, with 24 uses that refill after 7 days if run out?
Which brainpower roll helps me recall a crucial fact from a book, a clue, or my own memory?
What very rare wooden weapon can shrink into a small rod, grant +5 AC against one hit per rest, and fly back after I throw it?
Which magic pole glows green out to 10 feet and gives me an edge on tumbling checks?
Which mid-sized, mind-speaking fiend from the Nine Hells has 110 hit points and deals piercing damage to anything it grips each turn?
What fiend that hurls flame and is immune to fire and poison revives in the Nine Hells after death?
Which rare outfit gives me protection against one harm type of the GM's choosing, like acid, cold, or fire?
Is there a rare suit of body gear that randomly picks one harm to shrug off from ten options, including necrotic and thunder?

Can an enchanted sweeping tool travel alone up to a mile to a named, familiar spot and return when I call it?

A spell lets me steer enemies around as puppets, and they can shake it off with a roll each round. Which one?
Which 9th-level spell drops four flaming orbs within a mile, dealing 20d6 fire and 20d6 bludgeoning damage in 40-foot blasts?
If a flammable object sits in the area of a top-level wizard spell that rains fiery orbs, does it catch fire too?
Which 2nd-level spell conjures a 5-foot ball of fire I can roll up to 30 feet each turn, burning creatures who end their turn near it?
Can a rolling fire ball jump over pits 10 feet wide and barriers 5 feet tall, and does it light up nearby areas?
Which large lawful good celestial beast can heal a touched ally three times a day and has an edge on rolls against magic?
What celestial creature with 97 hit points is immune to being charmed, paralyzed, and poisoned, and can mentally talk 120 feet?
Which monk ability lets me mend myself as a quick extra move by rolling my unarmed fighting die plus Wisdom, reset after a full rest?
How often can a Wisdom-focused monk patch itself up before needing a full rest to recharge?
Which mid-sized, chaotic woodland fey has 31 hit points and can shove a Medium foe 10 feet with its hooves?
What fey creature can mock a visible foe within 90 feet, inflicting mental harm, and resists magic?
Which spell's trap can be set to unleash a sleep, fear, or pain effect over a 60-foot radius, with lingering dim light for 10 minutes?
If a creature steps into a lit 60-foot zone from a magic mark for the first time on its turn, what happens?

What undead creature can freeze you in place with a horrible stare from 60 feet away, and teleport away in a sandstorm when hit?
